baselineMethod: git ls-tree and git cat-file --batch; immutable canonical blobs, excluding untracked runtime artifacts
allowedDeltaRationale: The immutable aca19ec baseline is retained. After Typed Authority Architecture plus the reviewed C00-C31 roadmap, the measured canonical surface is 2204 files, 329014 nonblank lines, 14493472 UTF-8 bytes and 3623368 estimated prompt tokens. Since the previous reviewed budget, growth is dominated by regression tests (5750 added lines), implementation source (4415), and roadmap/contracts/evidence docs (2915), while the common complexity budget still adds zero public Kernel commands, workflow stages, Authorities, always-on agents, execution classes, memory services, vector DBs, Kernel model/project hardcoding, per-run reflection agents, or model-specific full prompt forks. Compiler-owned outputs remain excluded. The file cap is unchanged; line/byte/token headroom is bounded above the measured reviewed surface rather than auto-ratcheted.
